en.title: Accessibility Digest – May 26, 2026
en.summary: Today's highlights include India's EV report examining charging accessibility challenges, Framer's roadmap video featuring an accessibility checklist, Google's recommendation for descriptive alt text to improve image SEO and accessibility, and the launch of India's first AAC mobile app for intellectual disabilities.

highlights.title: India EV Report Examines Charging Accessibility Challenges
Framer Roadmap Video Includes Accessibility Checklist
Google Recommends Descriptive Alt Text for Image SEO
India Launches First AAC Mobile App for Intellectual Disability
